evidence.observation: B is deeper-bodied/curved and has a small pale patch on the head/shoulder area.
evidence.distinguishes_because: This is a persistent feature of B; A in the early observations is slenderer and uniformly dark.

evidence.observation: X is slender and uniformly dark, with no clear pale head/shoulder patch; its body profile matches the earlier A fish.
evidence.distinguishes_because: If X were B, it should retain B's deeper body and pale head/shoulder patch rather than the A-like slender profile.

evidence.observation: Y has a deeper, more curved body and shows a pale patch on the head/shoulder, matching B's earlier appearance.
evidence.distinguishes_because: Y matches B rather than the slender, unpatched A.

decision.limitation: Low resolution, variable lighting, and pose changes make the pale head/shoulder patch and body-depth cues subtle, so the comparison relies on those relative features.
